uncertainty_treatment.capital_note: total backer contribution capital is fixed by slot index; partial overlap changes which wallet owns a slot and this is recorded in raw JSONL
uncertainty_treatment.clustering: base_case_id is the paired unit; overlap is a named treatment
uncertainty_treatment.interval: no confirmatory intervals; paired differences retain scenario-level observations for future preregistration
uncertainty_treatment.overlap_definition: number of Judge identities also represented as Backers divided by eligible Judge identities
uncertainty_treatment.overlap_rounding: nearest integer, half up; realized ratio is overlap_judge_count / judge_pool_size
